prompt: What was the word that featured the least in the longest recorded quotation by the chimpanzee named after the recipient of the 2011 Sydney Peace Prize?
answer:
The word was **“you.”**

The chimpanzee was **Nim Chimpsky**, named after **Noam Chomsky**, the 2011 Sydney Peace Prize recipient. In Nim’s longest recorded utterance—

> “Give orange me give eat orange me eat orange give me eat orange give me you”

—“you” appears only once, fewer than any other word.
